items.statement: Correct neutral singlet oPmPCZ is used with an independently chosen and justified computational workflow.
items.expected: C44H28N4/CCDC 2466817 identity, method rationale, software/settings, geometry source, and SOC convention are documented.

items.statement: A complete outcome reports the optimized isolated-molecule S0 geometry and its validation.
items.expected: Cartesian coordinates with units, converged optimization, and a reported stationarity/frequency check or explicit limitation.

items.statement: A complete outcome reports individually assigned vertical S1, T1, T6, and T7 energies.
items.expected: Each named state has an energy in eV and an assignment supported by root/state-indexing evidence; reordering is explained rather than silently relabeled.

items.statement: A bounded limited outcome truthfully identifies why the complete result is unavailable.
items.expected: Affected object, failed validation, missing observables, attempted method, and a non-assessable conclusion are explicit; no placeholders are supplied.
